rules.source: INTENT_CONVERGENCE_SPEC 1.4 P4; BPHS Ashtakavarga chapters (BAV/SAV, Kakshya); Muhurta Chintamani (Tarabala)
rules.conditions: trigger planet in TRIG transits the primary E-house sign, the D1 E-lord's sign or a karaka's sign
exceptions: Mode B: NE (E-house sign is Lagna-based)

rules.source: INTENT_CONVERGENCE_SPEC 1.4 P4; BPHS Ashtakavarga chapters (BAV/SAV, Kakshya); Muhurta Chintamani (Tarabala)
rules.conditions: BAV of the transiting planet in that sign: >=4 support, >=5 strong, <=2 adverse; nodes have no BAV (NE)

rules.source: INTENT_CONVERGENCE_SPEC 1.4 P4; BPHS Ashtakavarga chapters (BAV/SAV, Kakshya); Muhurta Chintamani (Tarabala)
rules.conditions: SAV of the E-house sign >= 28 raises the BAV evidence weight

rules.source: INTENT_CONVERGENCE_SPEC 1.4 P4; BPHS Ashtakavarga chapters (BAV/SAV, Kakshya); Muhurta Chintamani (Tarabala)
rules.conditions: narrow to the 3deg45' kakshya whose lord contributed a bindu to the planet's BAV in that sign (prastara)

rules.source: INTENT_CONVERGENCE_SPEC 1.4 P4; BPHS Ashtakavarga chapters (BAV/SAV, Kakshya); Muhurta Chintamani (Tarabala)
rules.conditions: Mars/Sun (TRIG.fast) transiting or aspecting the E-house / E-lord sign give month-level triggers

rules.source: INTENT_CONVERGENCE_SPEC 1.4 P4; BPHS Ashtakavarga chapters (BAV/SAV, Kakshya); Muhurta Chintamani (Tarabala)
rules.conditions: transit over the natal nakshatra of the E-lord or a karaka when that nakshatra is tara 2,4,6,8,9 from the natal Moon

rules.source: INTENT_CONVERGENCE_SPEC 1.4 P4; BPHS Ashtakavarga chapters (BAV/SAV, Kakshya); Muhurta Chintamani (Tarabala)
rules.conditions: S = trigger + BAV>=4 + charged kakshya; W = trigger + BAV only; A = BAV<=2 for every trigger planet in the window
